held.view: This view is about final inspections: incoming and in-line ones join Every inspection and Open.

plan.label: Plan
plan.bound: On a plan the sample comes from the plan: change its profile on Sample & AQL.

view.amendedNone: No inspection has a countersigned correction.

failed.incoming: Incoming inspections could not be read.
failed.inline: In-line checks could not be read.

capped.inline: Only the newest 500 in-line checks are read: Show more reads no further for them.

bulk.finalOnly: Only final inspections take this: take the incoming and in-line rows out of the selection.
bulk.failed: The report of {number} could not be made.
bulk.noneHint: Pick signed final inspections on Quality › Inspections, then Print reports.

inline.openFirstPiece: Open: the run waits for this first piece to be approved on the line tablet (In-line inspection).
inline.openOnLine: Open: it is answered on the line tablet (In-line inspection).
inline.inspectorHidden: A worker (named only where the site's legal basis allows it)
inline.operatorHidden: Not named (the site's legal basis is not in place)
inline.noChecks: This check runs on no plan: one result, no checklist.
inline.noSignature: Not signed (only a first piece is signed)

report.title: Inspection report {number}
report.preview: Made now and kept nowhere until you keep a version (its banner says so).
report.failed: The report's versions could not be read.
report.pdfFailed: The report could not be made.
report.keepFailed: The version could not be kept.

noAccess.title: You cannot open this report
noAccess.body: Inspection reports need quality.inspections.view. Your administrator gives it.

held.kind: Reports are made of final inspections.
held.notSigned: The report is made once the result is signed.
held.none: Pick the signed inspections to print.
held.kindSome: Only final inspections have a report: take the others out of the selection.
held.notSignedSome: Some picked inspections are not signed yet: their report comes after the signature.

share.heading: Share report link
share.sub: A copy goes on a shipment that carries these garments; its customer opens it through the shipment's documents link. A newer version takes the older copy off the link (it stays as evidence).
share.send: and mail the link to the customer
share.sendHeld: Mailing the link needs shipping.manage (the shipment's own Send link)
share.doneSent: Version {version} shared on {shipment}; the link was mailed.
share.withdrewOlder_one: {count} older copy was taken off the link.
share.withdrewOlder_other: {count} older copies were taken off the link.
share.noShipment: No shipment carries these garments yet: share once they are packed.

held.noVersion: Keep a version first: a copy of a kept version is shared.
held.notShareable: This shipment is not packed yet (or cancelled): it cannot carry the report.
held.NOT_ON_SHIPMENT: This shipment carries no garment of this work order.
held.NO_VERSION: No version is kept yet: keep one first.
held.NO_SUCH_VERSION: That version does not exist any more: read the versions again.

checks.heading: Checks of {code} v{number}
checks.empty: This plan has no checks yet - the plan owner must add them.
checks.failed: The plan's checks could not be read.
checks.counts: {pass} passed · {fail} failed · {na} not applicable · {open} not checked
checks.photoBench: A photo, taken at the bench
checks.needNote: A failed check says what is wrong: write the note, then it saves.
checks.needReason: A critical check is not applicable only with the reason: write it, then it saves.
checks.keys: On a focused row: 1 Pass · 2 Fail · 3 Not applicable.

held.signed: Signed: the answers are read only.
held.mayNot: Only its inspector or assignee records the answers.

problem.conflict: Someone else changed this inspection: it was read again.

identity.heading: Serial and batch check
identity.serials: Expected {expected} · scanned {scanned} · missing {missing} · unknown {unknown} · without a number {noNumber}
identity.batchOpen: The batch label is not checked yet.
identity.ok: Clean: every garment checked is of this lot.
identity.fail: The check fails the lot: a missing or unknown number.
identity.open: Not done yet: it holds a pass.
identity.w1: W1's checklist has no serial or batch check: an inspection on a plan has one.

hold.serials: the serial check is not done
hold.batch: the batch label is not checked
hold.identityFails: the serial check fails the lot

aql.heading: How the sample was chosen
aql.readOnly: Read only: the counts come from the bench.
aql.failed: Sample & AQL could not be read.
aql.fixedWords: A fixed sample of the plan: {sample} of {lot}.
aql.typedWords: Typed by hand (W1): the numbers below are the inspector's.
aql.bench: Counts arrive from the bench (the counter on Final inspection); the office never edits them.

line.limit: {klass}: {found} found, accept up to {accept} - passes. One more rejects the lot.
line.reject: {klass}: {found} found, rejects at {reject} - the lot fails.

profile.heading: AQL profile
profile.fixed: A fixed sample: no AQL profile
profile.chain: Where a profile is looked for, in order
profile.differs: The stored sample is not the one its profile gives today (the profile changed after it was opened).

source.NAMED: Named by a person, with the reason

change.title: Change profile
change.subtitle: Before the first unit is counted only. The sample and the acceptance numbers follow the profile.
change.otherHeld: Another profile: needs quality.aql.view to list them
change.reasonHint: It is kept with the inspection.
change.reasonNeeded: Say why another profile, in at least 3 characters.
change.after: The profile is frozen once counting starts.

held.fixed: The plan samples a fixed number of units: no AQL profile applies.
held.frozen: The profile is frozen once counting starts.
held.signed: Signed: the sample stays as it was inspected.
held.mayNot: Only its inspector changes the profile, while it is open.

chart.heading: Measurement chart
chart.w1: Measurements come with an inspection plan: W1's checklist takes none.
chart.failed: The chart could not be read.
chart.keys: A value saves when you leave it; arrows move between the cells; an empty cell takes the value back.

held.record: Read only here: only its inspector records the values while it is open.
held.defects: The defects are read only here.

chart.sizeFirst: Pick the size measured: the lot has several sizes.

photos.heading: Required photo set
photos.empty: This plan asks for no photos.
photos.w1: W1's checklist asks for no photo set: an inspection on a plan has one.
photos.holds: A missing required photo holds Sign result.
photos.quarantined_one: {count} photo waits for the virus check
photos.quarantined_other: {count} photos wait for the virus check

defects.causesFailed: The cause codes could not be read.

gate.title: Release gate · {cell}
gate.rule: Garments are released when every check holds; who can clear each one is said.

open.WORK_ORDER: The work order is not ready to release.
open.INSPECTION: No passed inspection of these garments stands.
open.QUANTITY: Nothing is left to release in this cell.
open.SERIALS: The garments' serials are not all ready.
open.LABELS: The garment labels are not printed for every garment.
open.CERTIFICATE: No valid certificate covers this style, colour and size.
open.DOCUMENTS: The Declaration of Conformity or the user information is missing.
open.LOTS: A material lot used is not released (tests or documents pending).
open.MAKER: You made some of these garments: an inspector who made none releases them.
open.SECOND_PERSON: A second person must release these garments.

who.SECOND_PERSON: Another inspector or the quality manager

amend.heading: Amendments
amend.waitingCount_one: {count} correction waits for its second signature
amend.waitingCount_other: {count} corrections wait for their second signature
amend.locked: Signed results cannot be edited; a correction is an amendment with a second signature.
amend.notSigned: Corrections are asked once the result is signed.
amend.failed: The amendments could not be read.

step.secondRole: Another inspector or the quality manager

amend.whoMay: Another inspector or the quality manager countersigns with a fresh code; who asked never does.

rule.mine: You asked for this correction: another inspector or the quality manager countersigns.

amend.refuseSub: What was signed stays as it is. No code is asked: a refusal changes nothing.
amend.stepUp: Countersign the correction: it then stands on the signed result.

dialog.title: Amend signed result
dialog.amendedBefore: Corrected before: what stands now is that correction.
dialog.reasonHint: It is kept with the correction and printed on the report.
dialog.second: It waits for a second signature

done.requested: The correction waits for the second signature.
done.refused: Refused: the value stays as signed.

held.notSigned: Corrections are asked once the result is signed.
held.allWaiting: Every field a correction may take waits for its second signature.
held.mine: You asked for this correction: another inspector or the quality manager countersigns.

problem.reason: Say why, in at least 3 characters.
problem.conflict: Someone else answered or changed it: it was read again.
problem.codeCancelled: Not countersigned: the code was not entered.

refusal.NOT_SIGNED: The record is not signed yet.
refusal.VERDICT: This correction would change whether a line passes: reverse the release and inspect again instead.
refusal.WAITING: A correction of this field already waits for its second signature.
refusal.SAME_PERSON: Who asked for a correction never countersigns it.
refusal.STALE: The value moved since the correction was asked: ask again.

incoming.title: Incoming inspection {number}
incoming.openOnFloor: Open: it is recorded hide by hide on the tablet (Incoming inspection).
incoming.inspectorHidden: A worker (named only where the site's legal basis allows it)

method.FIXED: A fixed sample of the plan

incoming.hidesSub: {done} of {sample} done · accepted {accepted} · rejected {rejected} · to sort {toSort}

lotArea.WITHIN: The lot's area is within the tolerance: {percent} % against {tolerance} % ({hides} hides measured).
lotArea.SHORT: The lot's area is short: {percent} % against a tolerance of {tolerance} % ({hides} hides measured).
lotArea.OVER: The lot's area is over: {percent} % ({hides} hides measured).

incoming.claim: Purchasing may open a claim to the supplier.
incoming.nextAfter: The next step is said once it is decided.
incoming.lotRelease: Open the lot (its release is the lab's)

held.noHides: No rejected or to-sort hide to hold.

inline.hint: During production: first piece, cutting, roving, end of line.

kind.FIRST_PIECEHint: Holds the run until it is approved on the line.
kind.ROVINGHint: A check at an operation during the run.
kind.END_OF_LINEHint: Each bundle as it leaves the line.

inline.workOrderHint: The work order running on the line.
inline.bundleHint: Scan or type it; a first piece names the bundle it is made from.
inline.after: It is answered on the line tablet (In-line inspection); this opens its record.

held.noWorkOrders: Picking the work order needs workorders.view.

problem.workOrder: Pick the work order or type a bundle.
problem.bundle: A first piece names the bundle it is made from.

plan.heading: Plan
plan.failed: The plans could not be read: type the sample by hand, or try again.
plan.none: No final plan applies to this work order: type the sample by hand (W1).
plan.reasonHint: It is kept with the inspection.
plan.lotFirst: Type the lot size: the sample follows from the plan.
plan.typeIt: Type the sample by hand instead
plan.typedHint: Typed by hand (W1): type the acceptance numbers from your sampling table.

problem.none: Pick a plan, or type the sample by hand.
problem.reason: Say why another plan, in at least 3 characters.
problem.failed: The plans could not be read.
